V-M-PACK-CLI.Scenario: Derived commands are sorted by name and deduplicated, and unknown or non-CLI Loci derive none.
Command lines write one JSON line and map errors to exit codes 0, 1 and 2, including InvalidInput, UsageError and LocusNotFound.
Each CliInterface rule passes on the fixture and fails with its exact message on a broken variant.
The Bun entry writes the output to the process streams and sets the process exit code.
V-M-PACK-CLI.TraceAssertion: derive.test.ts, run.test.ts, archetype.test.ts and bun.test.ts prove the scenarios through the tests named by their rule ids and argv cases.
